title: Run-wait wording and detail completeness: an accurate UNKNOWN reason for a record-derived verdict on a Running row, and the detail's record on the global tail and shadowed retained rows
outcome: A run wait that takes its verdict from the host's record for a run the index still reads as running gives an accurate UNKNOWN reason rather than "results unreadable", and a run's full detail carries the verification record of the artifact it describes wherever that artifact's own registration exists.
acceptance: A run wait resumed from an Indeterminate, refused or locally refused record of a run the index still reads as running with a successful read names an UNKNOWN reason that does not say the results were unreadable; covered by a behaviour test.

GET /api/test-runs/{id} carries detail.verificationRecord for an artifact served from the global-summary tail or a compacted retained row whose run id now has a different live registration, taken from the registration matching the selection's request identity (live, else the retained row's own); covered by a behaviour test.
